What is the Hair & Beauty Award pay rate for 2026-27?

Under the Hair & Beauty Award (MA000005), the Level 1 base rate is $27.81/hr from 1 July 2026. The casual rate (including 25% loading) is $34.76/hr. Higher classification levels receive progressively higher rates.

Permanent employees under the Hair & Beauty Award receive 2x their base rate for Sunday work. For a Level 1 employee, that's $55.62/hr on Sundays.

Public holiday work under the Hair & Beauty Award is paid at 2.5x the base rate. For Level 1, that's $69.52/hr.
